Fix fresh deploys of the LiteLLM proxy failing during the image build: the prisma codegen step's nodeenv now downloads a Node that links against libatomic, which the slim base image does not ship ("node: error while loading shared libraries: libatomic.so.1"). The image now apt-installs libatomic1. Existing envs were unaffected because their images were already cached; only fresh env deploys (e.g. a new dev env) hit it.
